mapper.select: SELECT p.prod_date, p.equip_code, p.source, p.planned_min, p.downtime_min, p.run_min, p.prod_qty, p.good_qty, p.ideal_ct_min, v.availability, v.performance, v.quality, v.oee FROM production_daily p JOIN v_oee_daily v ON v.prod_date = p.prod_date AND v.equip_code = p.equip_code WHERE p.prod_date = #{prodDate} ORDER BY p.equip_code
SELECT prod_month, equip_code, source, availability, performance, quality, oee FROM v_oee_monthly WHERE prod_month = #{month} ORDER BY equip_code, source
